pairs.why: Almost identical saddles, but A's leather is a bit smoother and brighter, while B's darker, grainier leather leans toward the texture-heavy look the lessons rejected.
Same build in both; A has a slightly cleaner, smoother leather finish closer to the real cards, while B shows more grain and darker fold shading.
The pair is nearly the same, and A's smoother, more saturated leather matches the soft, polished finish of the real gloves and chair a little better than B's grainier panels.
A small edge to A for a smoother leather surface; B has more visible grain and darker, muddier skirt panels.
B's sticks are thicker and rounder with fewer tiny twig stubs, which reads smoother and more like the real cards; A is busier and more texture-heavy.
B is smoother and more saturated orange with cleaner stick forms, while A has more bark grain and fussy twigs, the overly textured look the lessons penalized.
B has fewer, smoother, lighter sticks and a cleaner silhouette; A has more small branch stubs and denser surface detail.
A's chunkier, fewer, softly shaded sticks look like a simple stylized prop, closer to the real cards than B's denser, grainier weave.
